verdict.rationale: LanceDB's docs have a dedicated quantization page. It says quantization compresses and stores vector indexes, and lists three techniques: Product Quantization, RaBitQ, and Scalar Quantization. Binary vectors with hamming distance and a forced flat scan for exact ground-truth results are also documented, which gives a way to measure recall loss. Missing for 10: an explicit documented accuracy/recall vs. memory trade-off for each technique, concrete memory or storage savings figures, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
